correctness.rationale: Applied Ghomi 2026 directional order theorem with the same upper-chord endpoint inequality for sigma_1 or sigma_2. Its one-direction conclusion is an orthogonal reflection symmetry. Compact convex body centroid belongs to all such symmetry planes; after centering three reflection maps are linear. First two normals (1,0,0) and (3/5,4/5,0) produce planar rotation R2 R1 with cosine -7/25, sine 24/25. Since cos(theta)=3/5, 2cos(theta)=6/5 is a rational noninteger algebraic integer contradiction if theta/pi rational; powers yield full SO(2) about z by density. Third reflection normal (0,1,1)/sqrt2 maps z to -y; conjugation gives SO(2) about y, whose rotations with z-axis rotations generate SO(3). Full rotational invariance forces ball. For arbitrary two prescribed directions pick a perpendicular spheroid axis a, yielding a smooth strictly convex nonround spheroid symmetric across both u^perp and v^perp, giving curvature-order equality. Covers dependent/antipodal u,v and both elementary curvatures.
